module "Pr_StaticBoolPin.dss"

product 0 MaterialFunction "MF_PrStaticBoolPin" backend=Graph
  %0 = FunctionInput(InputName="Colour", InputType="Vector3", IsOptional=false, SortPriority=0) : float3 @L6:C1 "Colour"
  %1 = FunctionInput(Description="Halve the colour", InputName="UseDimmed", InputType="StaticBool", IsOptional=true, PreviewValue=(0, 0, 0, 0), SortPriority=1) : bool @L6:C1 "UseDimmed"
  %2 = FunctionInput(InputName="Gain", InputType="Scalar", IsOptional=true, PreviewValue=(1, 1, 1, 1), SortPriority=2) : float @L6:C1 "Gain"
  %3 = Multiply(%0, %2) : float3 @L8:C21 "Result"
  %4 = Constant(Value=(0.5)) : float @L11:C27 "Result"
  %5 = Multiply(%3, %4) : float3 @L11:C18 "Result"
  %6 = StaticSwitch(%1, %5, %3) : float3 @L9:C5
  %7 = FunctionOutput(%6, OutputName="Result", SortPriority=0) @L6:C1 "Result"
  inputs %0, %1, %2
  outputs %7
